kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نخشوشب (form XII)
# نَخْشَوْشِبُ (naḵšawšibu) /nax.ʃaw.ʃi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْشَوْشَبَ (iḵšawšaba)
# نَخْشَوْشِبَ (naḵšawšiba) /nax.ʃaw.ʃi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْشَوْشَبَ (iḵšawšaba)
# نَخْشَوْشِبْ (naḵšawšib) /nax.ʃaw.ʃib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْشَوْشَبَ (iḵšawšaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
